doc.title: Ruthie Foster interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, February 28, 2023

title: Disagreeing with producers over material
summary: Producers often disagree on which originals to include; she respects them but sometimes insists.

story.theme_name: In the studio: making records, then and now
story.community_name: Record labels, producers and the business of making albums

blocks.x: Did you ever have a producer when you’re in the early stages of recording, getting ready to record, that didn’t quite agree with you on what original material to include on a record?

All the time, yeah. That’s all the time. There’s no animosity involved, it’s just kind of a “yeah, no.” That’s it. And you know, and I trust my producers. I’ve worked with several over the years and I trust and respect them all. And then sometimes it comes to, “No, I want that one. That one stays, that one stays.” Yeah.
